nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the ERC20 token name, set to "TrueShiba Inu" in the constructor.
Public string state variable holding the ERC20 token symbol, set to "TRUSHIB" in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable declaring the token decimals, set to 9 in the constructor.
Public uint256 total token supply, initialized to 100000000000000000000 in the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint) of token balances, written by the constructor, transfer and transferFrom and read by balanceOf and totalSupply.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances, written by approve and transferFrom and read by allowance.
Constructor that initializes name, symbol, decimals and _totalSupply and assigns the whole supply to msg.sender.
Public view function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)], mixing total supply with a balance lookup.
Public view function returning the balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Public view function returning the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner from allowed.
Public function writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emitting Approval.
Public function moving tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd and emitting Transfer.
Public function moving tokens from an arbitrary 'from' address without verifying that it is msg.sender or has a sufficient allowance, then decrementing allowed.
Library-style pure function performing c = a + b with an overflow require(c >= a).
Library-style pure function performing c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
Library-style pure function performing c = a * b with an overflow require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Library-style pure function performing c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
Caller-controlled address used as the index for balances and allowed and as the recipient of the initial supply.
transferFrom spends from an arbitrary 'from' address and debits allowed[from][msg.sender] without ever requiring that msg.sender is 'from' or that the allowance is sufficient.
Unchecked raw arithmetic expressions a + b, a - b, a * b and a / b inside the SafeMath helpers, relying only on inline require statements.
Subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply; if balances[address(0)] ever exceeds _totalSupply the operation underflows.
address parameter named tokenOwner used by balanceOf and allowance.
address parameter named spender used by allowance and approve.
uint parameter named tokens used by approve, transfer and transferFrom.
address parameter named to, the recipient in transfer and transferFrom.
address parameter named from, the debited account in transferFrom.
uint parameter a of the SafeMath helpers safeAdd, safeSub, safeMul and safeDiv.
uint parameter b of the SafeMath helpers safeAdd, safeSub, safeMul and safeDiv.
Named return variable c holding the result of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
Named return variable balance of balanceOf.
Named return variable remaining of allowance.
Named return variable success of approve, transfer and transferFrom.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the token name state variable.
Constructor writes the token symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor writes the _totalSupply state variable.
Constructor reads _totalSupply when transferring the initial supply.
msg.sender is used as the key of the balances mapping in the constructor and in transfer.
msg.sender is used as the key of the allowed mapping in approve and transferFrom.
Constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping to produce the returned balance.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to compute the circulating supply.
transfer reads and writes balances for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for the from and to accounts.
allowance reads the allowed mapping to produce the remaining value.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom writes allowed[from][msg.sender] decremented by safeSub.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
Parameter tokenOwner is the first index into allowed in allowance.
Parameter spender is the second index into allowed in allowance.
Parameter spender keys the allowed mapping in approve.
Parameter tokens is stored as the approved allowance in approve.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved in transfer.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved in transferFrom.
Parameter to is credited in transfer.
Parameter to is credited in transferFrom.
Parameter from is the account debited in transferFrom.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transfer invokes safeSub to debit msg.sender.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transferFrom invokes safeSub twice to debit balances and allowance.
Parameter a feeds the addition performed inside safeAdd.
Parameter b feeds the addition performed inside safeAdd.
Local result c is assigned the unchecked sum in safeAdd.
The missing allowance/ownership check governs every state write inside transferFrom.
Raw addition expression inside safeAdd is guarded only by a require statement.
Raw subtraction expression inside safeSub is guarded only by a require statement.
Subtraction in totalSupply can underflow if balances[address(0)] is larger than _totalSupply.
Named return variable balance is populated from the balances mapping in balanceOf.
Named return variable remaining is populated from the allowed mapping in allowance.
approve sets the named return variable success to true.
transfer sets the named return variable success to true.
transferFrom sets the named return variable success to true.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], making the caller-controlled address the source of funds.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key into allowed without checking ownership of from.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter tokenOwner exists only to index allowed inside allowance and carries no independent security semantics.
Parameter spender is consumed by approve when writing allowed[msg.sender][spender].
Parameter tokens is the value moved by transfer and does not require its own core node.
Parameter to is simply the recipient credited by transfer.
Parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom and is fully described by that function.
Parameter a is an arithmetic operand of the SafeMath helpers and is absorbed into the safeAdd node.
Parameter b is an arithmetic operand of the SafeMath helpers and is absorbed into the safeSub node.
Local c is only the named return of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
Local balance is the named return of balanceOf with no extra semantics.
Local remaining is the named return of allowance with no extra semantics.
Local success is the boolean return shared by approve/transfer/transferFrom and adds no security information.
